name: Tsukishita Ayasa
source:
A manga artist in a heated rivalry with “Saison”. Her boyfriend got into an accident, leaving him in a vegetative state and so she visits the host club for the first in hopes of finding a man to replace him. She's a strong-willed woman, but carries an extreme sense of loneliness within her heart, similarly to Shiki.

[Translated from the [url=https://enoshima210.work/2023/05/24/sini/]official website[/url]]
